visual_identity.core_identity: A severed troll arm still animated by supernatural regeneration, crawling as a grasping hand-creature without graphic gore.
visual_identity.silhouette: One elongated muscular forearm ending in an oversized clawed hand; fingers act as legs while the wrist and forearm trail behind.
visual_identity.head_features: No head or face; identity comes from troll skin, elongated arm proportions, and the oversized clawed hand.
visual_identity.body_shape: Single elongated arm only, with large hand, bent wrist, and finger-walking posture.
visual_identity.surface: Tough troll skin with sparse bumps; severed end simplified, closed, and non-gory.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly one troll arm and one clawed hand. The fingers provide the only walking/contact points; never add a torso, second arm, legs, or tentacles.

scene_identity.size_impression: A giant-sized arm roughly creature-scale on its own, clearly larger and heavier than a human arm.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Finger-walking with several claws visibly supporting the hand and forearm against floor, rubble, or another solid surface.
behavior_style: grasping or pulling at one nearby object
climbing low rubble using finger contact

accuracy_checks: clearly reads as a crawling severed troll arm

known_failure_modes.symptom: a torso, head, or extra limbs appear
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all anatomy except one elongated troll forearm and clawed hand
simplify the severed end to a clean non-gory fantasy regeneration surface
show multiple fingers visibly contacting the supporting surface
